verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a 2D video-generation tool, so image-to-video animation is a fair question to ask of it. Its documented input, however, is a reference video (file, phone recording or YouTube link) that it breaks down and re-creates. Following user-supplied character designs and accepting screenshots as chat feedback are adjacent features, not animating a still image into motion with subject and composition preserved.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved
